app.go:9:3: a job footprint sets CPU, Memory and Timeout only — executions are tasks, not serving instances, so there is no concurrency, no scaling, no idle CPU to throttle, no cold start to boost, no clients to keep affinity with and no connections to negotiate HTTP/2 over; WithParallel sets the fan-out and WithRetries the attempts (tako/footprint)
app.go:11:3: a singleton footprint sets CPU, Memory, Timeout and StartupBoost only — min=1 and concurrency=1 are what keep the loop's host alive and alone, and a loop whose only caller is its own health check has no clients to keep affinity with or negotiate HTTP/2 over (tako/footprint)
